description: Problem: several phase 3 families were insensitive: the models behaved correctly with the whole skill removed, so the candidate sections are unjudged (planning-lenses, removal-bookkeeping, slicing-discipline on Opus and Fable; code-config on Fable; tracker-ranking; tracker-holds, whose 1.00 to 0.56 drop did not survive correction). Dials were set on Sonnet and used on other models. These sections are neither shown to matter nor shown to be idle. Outcome: a recorded decision per family: raise the temptation and rescore, or leave unjudged. Decision gate: this work only informs deletions, and the owner decided to delete nothing without GPT 6.1 Sol, which was not run. Ask the owner first whether unjudged sections are worth more spend while deletions are off the table. If no, drop the item with that reason. If yes, set dials per counting model from a new discarded pilot (level nearest 50% in minus-skill), amend the pre-registration before scoring, and score at 36 per arm. tracker-holds may instead be topped up to the registered 70 per arm at its frozen dial. Guardrails: (1) agents under test run only in /tmp/omp-ablation sandboxes through evals/ablation/run.py or the loading-map probe; (2) do not change ~/.omp/agent/config.yml or ~/.omp/agent/rules while sessions run, and start no run while another evaluation is running; (3) write the pre-registration (hypothesis, arms, checks, sample, decision) and commit it before any scored session; smoke runs never count; (4) use a new out folder and a ledger with the ceiling stated here; stop at the ceiling and report, do not raise it without the owner's approval; (5) read at least 5 transcripts per arm before reporting any number, and report grader faults found; (6) delete or weaken no instruction or skill text on this evidence; (7) correct an existing report with a dated note, never by silently rewriting a published number; (8) scenario and scratch code that is part of the result is committed with it; (9) publish by task branch and draft PR with identity Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>. Spend ceiling 200 USD, confirmed with the owner at the gate. Extra: frozen dials and existing results are not edited; new dials are a dated amendment; the families that count only GPT Sol and the Sol run itself were dropped by the owner and are out of scope here.
